conference: ACHEMA
abstracts: <900 contributed — programme total is 'over 900 lectures, discussion panels and workshops' COMBINED, so contributed lectures alone are fewer
attendance: 106,001 participants from 141 nations (2024); 30,000+ congress listeners; 2,842 exhibitors
method: RUNG 8 — DECHEMA's own ACHEMA 2024 final report. Exact quotes: '106,001 participants from 141 nations came to this year's ACHEMA'; 'With more than 30,000 listeners in the congress'; 'over 900 lectures, discussion panels and workshops'; '2,842 exhibitors from 56 nations'. The 900 is an UPPER BOUND on contributed science, not a count of it: it lumps lectures with discussion panels and workshops, and ACHEMA's congress carries a large invited and industry component. So contributed abstracts are BELOW 900 - which is positive evidence against the floor, but only just, and derived rather than counted. NOT moved to the deleted sheet: per the trade-fair trap, the 106,001 headline is overwhelmingly trade visitors who cannot submit an abstract, and the real contributed figure has not been counted. NEXT: count the congress programme itself (achema.de/en/the-achema/congress-programme) for contributed lectures only - a rung 4/5 job.
notes: Straddles the ~900 floor on an upper bound. Rupert's call. Triennial - check Events/yr 0.33.

conference: Gordon Research Conferences (GRC series)
abstracts: no open call for abstracts; each meeting capped at 200 attendees
attendance: 200 max per conference; 395+ conferences and seminars per year
method: RUNG 2 — GRC's own About page states it plainly: 'GRC organizes over 395 Gordon Research Conferences (GRCs) and Gordon Research Seminars (GRSs) per year' and 'Each conference is limited to 200 attendees', with attendance by application and chair selection - 'scientists must apply to the conference and be selected by the conference chair to attend'. That is an application-and-selection model, NOT an open call for abstracts, so programme character is CURATED. DECISION-RELEVANT: whether this is kept as one row or exploded into 395 does not change the outcome - an individual GRC is capped at 200 people, so even at a 100% conversion it cannot reach the ~900 floor. Every one of the 395 fails the bar individually.
notes: Answers Rupert's open decision 1: one-row-or-many is MOOT for the bar. Same logic to test for Keystone, CECAM, Telluride.

conference: JASIS (Japan Analytical & Scientific Instruments Show)
abstracts: 0 contributed — the entire programme is exhibitor-presented or curated
attendance: 21,918 unique registered visitors (445 from overseas), 2024; 407 exhibiting organisations
method: RUNG 4 — counted from JAIMA's own JASIS 2024 結果報告書 (official post-show report PDF). THE TRAP THIS ROW EXISTS TO DOCUMENT: search returns '2024年の発表件数は312件' and a careless read writes 312 down as abstracts. The report shows what those 312 actually are - section 14, 新技術説明会（出展社による最新機器・技術の紹介）, i.e. NEW TECHNOLOGY PRESENTATIONS BY EXHIBITORS introducing their latest instruments: '発表会社数／テーマ件数：92社／312テーマ'. That is 92 vendors presenting product talks, not contributed science. The rest of the programme is the same in kind: JASISトピックスセミナー 42 titles, JASISスクエア 22, コラボレーション 7, WebExpo 63 - all curated or vendor-presented. There is NO open call for abstracts anywhere in the report. Contributed abstracts = 0. Attendance basis is 総登録来場者数 21,918 counted by barcode at the entrance, explicitly EXCLUDING exhibitor badges (出展社入場証の数は含まれない). Language searched: Japanese.
notes: Positive evidence of no contributed programme — a genuine OUT, not absence of evidence. Largest analytical trade show in Asia by attendance and still correctly excluded: the bar working.

conference: Менделеевский съезд по общей и прикладной химии (Mendeleev Congress)
method: RUNG 3 — counted the congress's own 7-volume abstract collection, downloaded as a single zip from the official site (media/sbornik-tezisov-310125.zip, 195MB; Cyrillic filenames need cp437->cp866 decoding to unzip). The Ru and Eng sets are PARALLEL EDITIONS of the same abstracts - counted the Ru set only (Tom_1..7, 2,861pp). Every abstract carries a type header, which is what makes the invited/contributed split exact: grep -ohE '(ПЛЕНАРНЫЙ|КЛЮЧЕВОЙ|ПРИГЛАШЕННЫЙ|УСТНЫЙ|ПОСТЕРНЫЙ|ЗАОЧНЫЙ) ДОКЛАД'. CONTRIBUTED PRESENTED = 539 УСТНЫЙ (oral) + 1,259 ПОСТЕРНЫЙ (poster) = 1,798. EXCLUDED as invited per Rupert 2026-09-12: 8 ПЛЕНАРНЫЙ + 52 КЛЮЧЕВОЙ + 224 ПРИГЛАШЕННЫЙ = 284. EXCLUDED as not presented: 606-625 ЗАОЧНЫЙ (in-absentia, publication-only, vols 6-7). Extracted TWICE (-layout and -raw): both agree EXACTLY on all five presented types; they differ only on ЗАОЧНЫЙ (606 vs 625), which is excluded anyway, so the decisive figure is unaffected. SANITY CHECK (rule 7): no stated total exists, so used two independent extractions plus extent - 1,798+284+~615 = ~2,700 items across 2,861pp = ~1pp each, the standard Russian format. Language searched: Russian.
notes: Quadrennial-ish (every ~4 years) - check Events/yr is 0.25, not 1.
